CompanyIntroduction.heading: Plating Services for Industrial Customers
CompanyIntroduction.paragraph1Strong: HANIN Plating Industrial Joint Stock Company
CompanyIntroduction.paragraph1Rest: specializes in plating on ABS plastic and metal substrates, and also paints and prints on plastic and metal products.
CompanyIntroduction.paragraph2: The company was founded in {{founded}}; the factory is at Lot {{lot}}, Quang Minh Industrial Park, Hanoi, on a site of {{area}} m². The factory has {{staff}} employees. More than {{customers}} customers use the processing services.

field.label: Field
field.note: ABS plating, metal plating, PVD, painting and printing

target.label: Customers
target.note: Automotive, home appliances, sanitary ware and kitchen equipment

location.label: Location
location.note: Address: Lot {{lot}}, Quang Minh Industrial Park

CompanyIntroduction.paragraph3: HANIN belongs to the Hanin Tech system, which includes the IPM mold workshop, the HANIN plating factory, the Press workshop and the Showa workshop, with {{hqStaff}} people.

support.title: Engineering

DevelopmentDirection.subtitle: Technical requirements are set on the drawing and checked with equipment at the factory.

precision.desc: Plating follows the requirements on the customer's drawing, with plating thickness measured.

stability.title: Plating Tank Control
stability.desc: Plating solution analysis and Hull cell tests in the analysis lab.
